Sign out of an instance

Usage: hpy happyview logout [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json       Print the result as JSON on stdout
      --url <URL>  The instance, e.g. https://api.example.com (default: HPY_HV_URL, else the only
                   one you are signed in to)
      --no-input   Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible actions still need
                   --yes. Implied without a terminal
  -C <DIR>         Run as if started in DIR
  -h, --help       Print help
